description: This file defines service functions for managing membership plans and user memberships in a gym management system. It includes creating, listing, updating, deleting plans, subscribing users to plans, cancelling memberships, and retrieving current membership status.

methods.name: MembershipPlan create_plan(db: Session, name: str, price_cents: int, interval: str, active: bool = True)
methods.description: Creates a new membership plan with specified parameters.

methods.name: list[MembershipPlan] list_plans(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns a list of all membership plans.

methods.name: MembershipPlan update_plan(db: Session, plan_id: int, **fields)
methods.description: Updates attributes of an existing membership plan identified by plan_id.

methods.name: None delete_plan(db: Session, plan_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a membership plan identified by plan_id.

methods.name: Membership subscribe_user_to_plan(db: Session, user_id: int, plan_id: int)
methods.description: Subscribes a user to a specified plan, activating membership and creating a payment record if in test mode or no payment provider set.

methods.name: Membership cancel_current_membership(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Cancels an active membership for a user.

methods.name: Membership|None get_current_membership(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the latest membership (active or pending) for a user.

ctags.name: create_plan
ctags.pattern: /^def create_plan(db: Session, name: str, price_cents: int, interval: str, active: bool = True) ->/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, name: str, price_cents: int, interval: str, active: bool = True)

ctags.name: get_current_membership
ctags.pattern: /^def get_current_membership(db: Session, user_id: int) -> Membership | None:$/

ctags.name: subscribe_user_to_plan
ctags.pattern: /^def subscribe_user_to_plan(db: Session, user_id: int, plan_id: int) -> Membership:$/
